assertions.assertion: Explains reference tokens allow immediate revocation by deleting the persisted grant record while JWTs remain valid until expiry
assertions.rationale: Says reference revocation is immediate by deleting stored grant and JWTs can't be revoked before exp.

assertions.assertion: Explains the trade-off that APIs must call the introspection endpoint (or use its cache), so they need connectivity to IdentityServer, a poor fit for offline/air-gapped scenarios
assertions.rationale: Says APIs must call introspection (or cache), needing live IdentityServer connection, which offline lacks.

assertions.assertion: Suggests short-lived JWTs with refresh tokens as an alternative for offline scenarios
assertions.rationale: Recommends short-lived JWTs (5-15 min) with refresh tokens.
